name: vision_analyze
description: Analyze an image or a video. Accepts a local path or an http(s) URL. Video (mp4/mpeg/mov/webm) needs a video-capable model; local videos are capped at 24 MB.

image.description: Local image/video path or an http(s) URL.

prompt.description: Question or instruction for the image analysis. Defaults to a concise description of the image.
